name: muapi-action-figure-generator
tagline_zh: 上传一张照片，秒变专属3D手办，还附赠收藏级玩具包装盒。朋友看了都想要，发朋友圈必炸。
tagline_en: Turn any photo into a custom 3D action figure with collectible packaging. Instant wow for your feed.
desc_en: Convert a photo of a person into a custom 3D action figure, complete with collectible toy packaging.
why_zh: 不只是换脸，而是完整生成玩具本体与包装，连开窗盒和背卡都还原，像真从货架拿下来。
why_en: It generates the full toy package—figure, window box, and back card—so it looks shelf-ready, not just a face swap.
